draft.body:
Hi Rahul,

Thanks for the time on the demo. Here is what I took away, and what we said we would do next.

The demo landed. After-hours routing, answering machine detection and consent-tracked texting all resonated with you.

What we covered:
- You said downtime is a dealbreaker, that you cannot be down during patient hours at all.

Next steps:
- I will send the SOC 2 report and the TCPA one-pager to your office manager, both by Friday.
- You will pull the RingHawk call-volume report and send it over, early next week, so I can size the deal.
- Once those documents are exchanged, we both move to pricing.

Every line above came from something said on the call. If I got any of it wrong, tell me and I will fix it.

Best,
Maya
